title: SupplyProduced
description: A side's source pool gained income at an economy window (CONTRACTS §6; ECONOMY EC-1, EC-10; NX-412 part 1): one per side per window, amount = the whole stock units added (the floor plus each held, uncontested node, capped at storage); none when 0, and none for a side in unlimited mode (EC-15). Public view: ENEMY dropped (proposed).
